question: The 'Mangla' oil field is located in which district of Rajasthan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Barmer**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Mangla Oil Field** is one of the largest onshore oil fields in **India**.
 
• It is located in the **Barmer district** of **Rajasthan**.
 
• The Mangla field was discovered in **2004** and is part of the **Rajasthan Block RJ-ON-90/1**, operated by **Cairn India** (now part of Vedanta Resources).
 
• It is a key contributor to India's **domestic crude oil production**.
 
• The field has a production capacity of around **150,000 barrels per day**, making it a significant source of energy for the country.
 
• The Mangla oil field is known for its use of **enhanced oil recovery (EOR) techniques**, such as polymer flooding, to maximize oil extraction.
 
• The discovery and development of the Mangla field have boosted **economic activities** and **employment opportunities** in the Barmer region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Kota**__

 __
 
• **Kota** is a major city in Rajasthan and is known as the **education hub** of India due to its coaching centers for competitive exams.
 
• The city is also famous for its **Kota Doria sarees** and the **Chambal River**, which flows through it.
 
 
 
• **Jaipur**__
 __
 
• **Jaipur**, the capital city of Rajasthan, is known as the **Pink City** due to its distinct pink-colored buildings.
 
• It is a popular tourist destination, featuring attractions like the **Hawa Mahal, Amber Fort,** and **City Palace**.
 
 
 
• **Bharatpur**__
 
 
• **Bharatpur** is famous for the **Keoladeo National Park**, a UNESCO World Heritage Site and a significant bird sanctuary.
 
• The park attracts a large number of migratory birds, including the rare **Siberian crane**.
